change.before: "L7 network policy with terminatingTLS loaded ca.crt key from secrets"
change.after: "L7 network policy with terminatingTLS does not load ca.crt key from secrets by default"

of.needed: whether environment uses L7 network policies with terminatingTLS that rely on ca.crt loading

consequence.statement: L7 network policies with terminatingTLS will no longer load ca.crt from secrets by default, preventing Envoy from incorrectly requiring client certificates; environments relying on the old behavior must set --use-full-tls-context=true.
consequence.remediation: If the old behavior is required for compatibility, set --use-full-tls-context=true when running cilium

assertion.statement: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from secrets by default; set --use-full-tls-context=true to restore the old behavior.
